# @univerjs-pro/bases-thread-comment-ui

`@univerjs-pro/bases-thread-comment-ui` adds row comment actions to Grid, Kanban, Gallery, and Calendar views and opens the shared thread comment panel.

## Installation

```sh
pnpm add @univerjs-pro/bases-thread-comment-ui
```

Import the package CSS and register `UniverBasesThreadCommentUIPlugin` after the Bases UI plugin.
